From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: ClarityAI POC - Success criteria & next steps

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation and clear alignment on the primary evaluation goals. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the proposed success criteria, high-level evaluation plan, timeline, and immediate next steps so we can get the POC scheduled. Please reply with any edits and confirm owners where noted.

Proposed success criteria (what ClarityAI will validate):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation < 350ms for batch size 1 on your sample queries.
- Cost: token cost under $0.0009/token equivalent for the target throughput.
- Quality: human-evaluated relevance score >= 4.2/5 on a 100-sample set using your scoring rubric.
- Stability: no crashes or memory spikes during 8-hour continuous run at expected throughput.

Evaluation plan (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (prep): exchange sample data + access; Redwood provides staging instructions and a POC plan doc.
- Week 1: baseline runs on sample set; measure latency/cost; collect outputs for human review.
- Week 2: optimization (batching, quantization profile) and re-run.
- Week 3: longer stability run + final evaluation and handoff to Eng for rollout discussion.

Timeline: target kickoff week of 3/29, wrap by 4/19 (3-week active window).

Ownership / contacts:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, POC coordination), Marcus Lin (Infra/Onboarding).
- ClarityAI: Alex Johnson (POC lead), Emily Carter (data / QA).

Immediate next steps:
1) Alex: confirm sample dataset delivery and preferred kickoff date (we proposed 3/29).
2) Alex/Emily: share expected query volume and any security constraints for the staging environment.
3) Redwood: circulate POC plan and access steps (I will attach docs).
4) Marcus: prepare staging checklist and temporary credentials once we have sample data.

Attachments: draft POC plan (will attach in follow-up), SOW template (for intake), and a short access checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa

Hi all,

Quick note from infra: the access steps Marissa attached look good. A couple of clarifications so we size and provision correctly:
- Preferred data delivery: S3 (us-west-2) with a read-only IAM role. If S3 is not possible, a signed HTTPS link is fine but we'll need file listing metadata.
- Expected payload per request (avg token size) — helps pick instance and KV cache sizing.
- Expected concurrency pattern: steady 30 QPS with ~200 QPS short bursts; confirmation will determine whether we use a single large instance or a small autoscaling pool.
- Network: if ClarityAI requires IP allowlisting, send the list of egress IPs we should allow (we will provide our staging egress block).

Provisioning timeline: once we have data + IAM role/link and QPS confirmation, we can provision temporary staging credentials and a test endpoint within 4 hours.

I'll stand by to provision as soon as we have the link.

Thanks,
Marcus
